_doc: Registered driver catalog for the Cost Index dispatch. Each entry is a STANDING, public-sourced correlation between a driver class and the ingredients it plausibly moves — never an invented dated event. The dispatch may attach a driver as context to a flagged mover ONLY when (a) the ingredient is in `affects` and (b) the ingredient's measured direction this week agrees with `directionExpected`. Language is pitched to `strength`; every line carries 'association, not a measured cause' and a cite drawer with `source` + `retrievedAt`. The do-not-assert line: never a magnitude attributed to a driver, never causation, never a forecast. Gate: scripts/check-cost-index-drivers.mjs.

_strengthVocab.correlation: tracks / moves with / standing context (association, not cause)
_strengthVocab.strong-correlation: consistently moves ahead of / a reliable lead on
_strengthVocab.mechanism-established: feeds directly into (reserved for chains the methodology treats as mechanism, e.g. feed -> protein)

drivers.label: Avian influenza (HPAI)
drivers.mechanism: Laying-flock and broiler losses from HPAI detections tighten egg and poultry supply
drivers.source: USDA APHIS — Confirmed HPAI Detections in Commercial & Backyard Flocks
drivers.note: Standing supply risk for eggs and poultry. Spoken only when the measured read is up — a detection backdrop does not explain an easing print.

drivers.label: Desert-Southwest growing conditions
drivers.mechanism: Heat, drought, and short harvest windows in the CA/AZ desert growing regions tighten leafy-green supply
drivers.source: U.S. Drought Monitor; USDA AMS Specialty Crops movement & shipment reports
drivers.note: Leafy greens cluster on the same growing regions, so they often flash together when the region is stressed.

drivers.label: Field-crop growing conditions
drivers.mechanism: Heat, drought, and harvest-window timing in the major U.S. growing regions tighten field-crop supply
drivers.source: U.S. Drought Monitor; USDA AMS Specialty Crops movement & shipment reports
drivers.note: Broader field produce; same growing-condition channel as the leafy greens, different crops.

drivers.label: Import supply & cross-border logistics
drivers.mechanism: Import-dominated items track foreign growing supply and cross-border / ocean logistics rather than domestic harvest
drivers.source: USDA AMS import & terminal-market movement; NOAA Fisheries trade data (seafood); EIA diesel (freight)
drivers.note: For these the domestic-harvest story does not apply; supply and freight from the source country do.

drivers.label: Energy & oilseed costs
drivers.mechanism: Oilseed crush economics and energy/biofuel demand move edible-oil costs
drivers.source: USDA NASS; FRED oilseed & energy series; EIA
drivers.note: Edible-oil channel, distinct from the produce and protein chains.
